dialogues.speaker: Darcy
dialogues.text: I actually like living here! When I was outside, I lived a life with my days and nights all topsy turvy, sleepless at night, dispirited and listless during the day...

dialogues.speaker: Darcy
dialogues.text: But ever since I arrived in the Fortress of Meropide, I've led a regular and healthy life!

dialogues.speaker: Darcy
dialogues.text: If you have had similar issues, I recommend you stay a while longer!
